_doc: Progressive unlocks of the lobby screens (design/ux/progressive-unlocks.md, user 2026-11-23): a screen opens once the slot has won stage N (slot.best >= N). 0 = open from the start. Bộ thẻ also holds Cây thẻ. Thử thách has its own gate in challenges.json (unlock 10). class_<id> (user 2026-11-26: every class unlocks step by step): that class can be created once any character has won stage N; Kiếm sĩ has none (open).
